title: D1 foreign key to an unseeded parent row causes an opaque 500 on insert

detect.signal: inserting a row whose FK column points at a parent table that may not have the referenced row seeded (e.g. best_practices.infra_id -> infrastructures.id)

directive: D1 enforces foreign keys. Inserting a child row whose FK parent does not exist fails with 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed', and API handlers that catch-and-return a generic 500 hide it. When a child insert takes a caller-supplied parent id, ENSURE the parent exists first (upsert with onConflictDoNothing) for ANY id, not just a special 'other' case. Also: never swallow the real error — logger.error(actual) before returning 500, or you debug blind.
fix_example:
await db.insert(parent).values({ id, name: name ?? id }).onConflictDoNothing();
// then insert the child that references parent.id
evidence: 2026-07-23: saving a best_practice with infra_id='cloudflare-workers' 500'd because resolveInfraId only created the infrastructures row for infraId==='other'. Fixed in db/best-practices.ts.
